#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /etc/sysconfig/inventory-config-sync
tmp=$(/usr/bin/mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)
trap '/usr/bin/rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/ssh -T -i /root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_known_hosts root@"$SOURCE_HOST" </dev/null > "$tmp"
/usr/bin/chown root:root "$tmp"
/usr/bin/chmod 0644 "$tmp"
/usr/bin/mv -f "$tmp" /etc/inventory/app.conf
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/sbin/restorecon /etc/inventory/app.conf
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync; cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
